rule: Rule for complaints: the insurer resolves a complaint within 14 days. If it does not accept the complaint, it gives reasons that cite the policy terms.
quote: Insurers should provide resolution to the complaint within 14 days along with the reasons for not accepting the complaint with specific reference to the relevant terms and conditions of the policy.
label: PUBLISHED

rule: Rule for grievance systems: the insurer links its grievance portal to IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal, so policyholders can register and track a grievance online.
quote: Insurers shall integrate its grievance portal with the Bima Bharosa portal to facilitate the registering/ tracking of grievance on-line by the policyholders.
label: PUBLISHED
notes: quote found word for word on the official page

rule: Rule for status checks: a policyholder can track a complaint on Bima Bharosa, on the insurer's grievance portal, or by calling the insurer's call centre.
quote: The complainant can track the status of the complaint by logging-in to the Bima Bharosa or to the insurer's grievance portal or on the call centre of the insurer.
label: PUBLISHED
notes: quote found word for word on the official page

rule: Rule for commercial calls and messages: insurers and insurance intermediaries must follow the TRAI rules.
quote: Insurers and Insurance Intermediaries sending commercial communications to their existing or prospective customers shall fulfil the extant regulatory requirements prescribed by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India.
label: PUBLISHED
notes: quote found word for word on the official page

rule: Rule for language: a life insurer gives the proposal form in Hindi or English, and in a regional language if the prospect asks.
quote: Proposal form will be made available in Hindi or English. However, if sought by the prospect, it will also be provided in regional language.
label: PUBLISHED
notes: quote found word for word on the official page

rule: TRAI numbers for promotional and service calls: promotional auto-dialer or robo voice calls should use 140-series numbers. Service and transactional ones should use 1600 or another series set for the purpose. This is TRAI's explanatory text on its 12 Feb 2025 amendment.
quote: As far as promotional Voice Calls through Auto-dialer/Robo calls are concerned, these should be permitted through 140-series numbers only and Service and Transactional Voice Calls through Auto-dialer/Robo calls should be permitted through 1600 or any other series allotted for the purpose.
label: PUBLISHED
notes: quote found word for word on the official page

rule: TRAI consent: the Digital Consent Acquisition (DCA) facility records a customer's consent to commercial communication from a sender. This is TRAI's explanatory text on its 12 Feb 2025 amendment.
quote: DCA facility enables acquisition of the consent of the customer to receive commercial communication from a Sender for a particular product or service
label: PUBLISHED
